intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. This page compares recorded fees, placements and ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}.

IPS Academy vs Shri G.S. Institute of Technology & Science is a private campus compared with a well-known government engineering college. SGSITS has the older NIRF Engineering mention and the higher recorded 2023 figures on this page.

sections.heading: IPS Academy vs Shri G.S. Institute of Technology & Science for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose SGSITS if you want a government engineering college in Indore, a JEE Main route, and the higher recorded 2023 figures, at an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹26 lakh.
Choose IPS Academy if you are taking the state PET route and want a private campus. IPS has no NIRF Engineering rank here, and its recorded 2023 average is ₹5 lakh, with a highest of ₹12 lakh.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Our records list a year-wise total of ₹1.05 lakh for IPS Academy. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total, until you check the institute's current fee notice.

SGSITS has recorded tuition of ₹49,725 a year. A one-time or 'other' row of ₹5,450 also appears in the raw data; that is below the ₹10,000 professional fee floor and is not the programme tuition, so we do not treat it as the SGSITS fee.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a recorded 2023 year, so the figures can be read together more fairly than on many other comparisons.

SGSITS's 2023 figures are an average package of ₹6 lakh and a highest package of ₹26 lakh. IPS Academy's 2023 figures are an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: IPS Academy lists PET Madhya Pradesh on this page. SGSITS lists JEE Main. In recent years, Madhya Pradesh engineering counselling has also used JEE Main ranks for many seats.
Read the current DTE Madhya Pradesh counselling brochure for the exact test and eligibility that apply to each college.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. SGSITS is a long-established government institute in the city. IPS Academy is a separate private campus.
If you already plan to stay in Indore, the choice is about college type, official fees and the 2023 records, not a change of city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On the data we hold, SGSITS is the stronger documented side: a government institute, lower recorded tuition of ₹49,725 a year, a 2021 NIRF Engineering rank of 181, and higher 2023 figures.
IPS Academy may still suit you if you want a private campus and have checked its current official fee and placement notices.
Do not use the ₹5,450 SGSITS row as the college fee. Confirm both official circulars for your quota.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, IPS Academy or SGSITS Indore, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: SGSITS is the government institute, with recorded 2023 figures of a ₹6 lakh average and a ₹26 lakh highest package, and a 2021 NIRF Engineering rank of 181. IPS Academy is private, with 2023 figures of a ₹5 lakh average and a ₹12 lakh highest package, and no NIRF Engineering rank here.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for IPS Academy vs SGSITS?
faqs.answer: Our records list ₹1.05 lakh a year for IPS Academy and tuition of ₹49,725 a year for SGSITS. A ₹5,450 SGSITS row in the raw data is below the professional fee floor and is not the programme tuition.

faqs.question: Which exams do IPS Academy and SGSITS accept?
faqs.answer: IPS Academy lists PET Madhya Pradesh. SGSITS lists JEE Main. Confirm the current DTE Madhya Pradesh counselling rules, which may use JEE Main for many seats.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for IPS Academy and SGSITS?
faqs.answer: Both have recorded 2023 figures. SGSITS shows an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹26 lakh. IPS Academy shows an average of ₹5 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh. These are historical figures, not a guarantee.

faqs.question: Are IPS Academy and SGSITS in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, on different campuses. SGSITS is the government institute in the city.
